high_level_description: stc brand style, a 2x2 collage of four portrait photographs of a mustached man in a white collared shirt, overlaid with a warm yellow lens flare.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A blurred, neutral-toned backdrop in each of the four panels.

elements.desc: A middle-aged man with a mustache, wearing a white collared shirt, photographed from slightly different angles in each of the four panels.
A warm yellow lens flare overlay glowing across the entire collage.
